product_one_liner.value: Maximum provides an AI-native operating system that helps banks run core banking, payments, risk, and operational workflows and build custom AI agents.
product_one_liner.notes: The company's homepage describes its product as an AI-native operating system for banks and highlights custom agents and banking platform capabilities.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer lists no pricing link; it offers a request-access/contact route rather than public pricing.

named_customers.notes: The cited reporting says no product was yet in production at a named institution. The company website has no customer list or case studies.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 11 employees, falling within this band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists Miami, Florida as the headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Tracxn lists 2025 as the founding year; founder Randy Fernando's profile likewise identifies his Maximum tenure as starting in 2025. LinkedIn company metadata separately reports 2026, so the cited independent company profile and founder record support 2025.

eng_blog.notes: The company site links to a newsroom rather than a technical blog; the site does not show two engineering posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The site navigation and footer provide no public product documentation or help center link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open listings are Senior Staff Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer, and Senior Software Engineer; none has an AI/ML or data-science role title.

model_provider.notes: The public site and privacy policy do not identify a model or AI provider; the privacy policy refers to third-party service providers without naming them.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy and legal pages reviewed do not name any of the specified certifications.

last_funding.notes: The company announced a $30 million seed funding round on August 3, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The $30 million seed round was announced in August 2026, within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The listed openings are software engineering positions; none is SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: Maximum emerged from stealth and introduced its AI-native banking operating system in August 2026, within six months of the run date.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No checkable full team roster or dated C-level/VP join-or-departure record was found to establish a negative.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The accessible job listings contain no named CRM or sales/marketing systems.
